assets.name: 菁英・日耀聖庭
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-quality static background plate for an existing AAA Greek mythology action-RPG's fullscreen responsive world scene. Image 1 is a CAMERA, composition and framing reference only, not an edit target; invent a fresh environment as specified below.
OUTPUT: portrait 1024x1536 pixels, 2:3 aspect ratio, full bleed, opaque. Maintain the reference's elevated three-quarter camera and expansive walkable floor perspective. This is a scrolling navigable world background, NOT a UI screenshot, poster or character illustration.
Composition: approximately the top 18–22% may show distant scenery. Most of the image, especially x=12%–88%, y=28%–94%, is continuous unobstructed walkable paving, painted with rich material detail but low contrast broad tonal variation. Camera follows a character and crops heavily in portrait AND landscape, so never rely on the edges to communicate the theme. Use floor materials, ambient light and sparse inlay to communicate the environment throughout the middle. Avoid placing large focal landmarks, pedestals, holes, walls, fire, rubble or railings inside the walkable middle. Put scenic architecture at extreme edges and far background.
Style: premium Korean AAA MMORPG environment matte painting, physically believable stone and metal, careful architectural perspective, sophisticated color grading and detailed weathered surfaces, high-definition polished game art.
Constraints: environment only. NO UI, borders, captions, letters, logos, characters, creatures, item icons, red or blue orbs, health bars, central magic rings or central objects. Do not bake mode badges or effects into the background. Preserve exactly the portrait aspect ratio and broad floor composition of the reference.
Environment: An expansive sun-warmed ivory limestone sanctuary terrace of Olympus, restrained champagne-gold bronze inlaid laurel geometry in the paving, weathered sculptural colonnades and monumental statues confined to the far left and far right margins, distant sunlit Greek acropolis only in the uppermost 18 percent. Rich warm amber sunlight rakes the worn stone, royal navy textiles at peripheral ruins. Noble ancient-Greek grandeur, very readable neutral gray-cream central floor, no yellow blanket filter.
